name: Harvest Table
education: An optional discovery objective about cultivation and food processing. Bread-making predates farming; this gameplay chain is not a universal chronology. Historical explanations are free and reading is not required for the reward.

name: Bronze Workshop
education: Connect earlier gameplay foundations with ore reduction, alloying and working metal. These are discovery objectives, not a complete historical manufacturing procedure.

name: Marks and Materials
education: Explore earlier plant and clay materials alongside writing and records. Writing has independent traditions; this collection does not require one historical sequence or any reading to earn its discovery reward.
